parameters.jsCode: const parse=(value)=>{if(value&&typeof value==='object')return value;if(typeof value==='string'){try{return JSON.parse(value)}catch{return {}}}return {}};const raw=parse($json);const response=parse(raw.body??raw);const d=parse(response.data??response);const statusCode=Number(raw.statusCode??response.statusCode??0);const p=[];if(statusCode>=400)p.push('HTTP health request failed ('+statusCode+')');if(response.success!==undefined?(response.success!==true||d.status!=='ok'):d.status!=='ok')p.push('API health is not OK');if(d.cache!=='ready')p.push('Redis cache: '+(d.cache||'unknown'));if(d.media?.mode!=='local')p.push('Media mode: '+(d.media?.mode||'unknown'));if(d.media?.localVolumeAttached!==true)p.push('Persistent media volume is not attached');if(d.media?.localDirectory!=='/app/backend/uploads')p.push('Media directory: '+(d.media?.localDirectory||'unknown'));const s=p.length?'unhealthy':'healthy';const st=$getWorkflowStaticData('global');const prev=st.lastState||'unknown';st.lastState=s;const notify=s!==prev&&(s==='unhealthy'||prev==='unhealthy');const message=s==='healthy'?'SchoolManagement recovered | Revision: '+(d.revision||'unknown')+' | Cache: '+(d.cache||'unknown')+' | Media volume: attached':'SchoolManagement health alert | Problems: '+p.join('; ')+' | Revision: '+(d.revision||'unknown');return[{json:{state:s,healthy:s==='healthy',notify,message,revision:d.revision||null,problems:p}}];
